description: This file defines the EntryCollection class in the OrangeHRM LDAP module. It manages a collection of EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair objects and provides counting and retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: EntryCollection
classes.description: Represents a collection of LDAP entry groups with counting capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the collection with an array of EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair objects.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of entries across all contained collections, caching the result.

methods.name: getCollections
methods.description: Returns the array of contained EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair objects.
